course.scope: stochastic training episode totals; not a frozen evaluation

terrain.level_sampling: all10 fixed rows from launch; no staged admission
terrain.progress_scope: 2m signed traversal with terrain-height variation; not gyro pass metric

single_step_curriculum.scope: stochastic training episode totals; not a frozen evaluation

pitch_stability.phase_age_source: action issuance counter captured before physics
pitch_stability.ground_contact_gate: per-episode latched first wheel contact>5N, charged through unintended unloading
pitch_stability.velocity_projection: Exact gravity-orthogonal heading plane, target-only before source weighting
pitch_stability.scope: Cumulative full-DR on-policy metrics, not fixed model evaluation

r2_landing.metric: posture/command recovered after25continuous policy endpoints; geometric near-wheel support, not claimed graduation; end failures can include physics guard
r2_landing.reset_height: local ground + max(uniform(.12,.42), feasible_bank_support+.08); feasible support<=.34

forward_tracking.selection: FLAT ONLY: cmd_vx>=1.5 and abs(cmd_wz)<=1; body-frame vx, varying heights/transients; rollout24steps; not fixed-task pass

spec.keep_domain: 1229 retained flat/rough including pitch targets; stair uses current native LQR demonstrations

interpretation_limits: Static skill BC is one term of combined PPO+BC+retention; not a pureBC-only run
Teacher pitch8deg can occur in later skill phases; unsupported contact-state combinations are the coverage gap
No full PPO success does not mean zero shaped lift/progress reward
No new sampling percentages or added training budget are applied
